cve_summary: In GPAC 0.7.1 and earlier, gf_text_get_utf8_line in media_tools/text_import.c in libgpac_static.a allows an out-of-bounds write because a certain -1 return value is mishandled.
commit_message: check error code on call to gf_utf8_wcstombs (#1177)
docstring:
Summary: This code fragment processes a UTF-16 encoded string, converting it to a UTF-8 representation while handling endianness based on the `unicode_type` variable.

Parameters: N/A

Returns: None

Logic: The code begins by checking the endianness of the input based on the `unicode_type`. If it is big-endian, it processes the string differently than if it is little-endian. It swaps pairs of characters in the `szLine` array until it reaches the end of the string. After the character swapping, it converts the modified string from UTF-16 to UTF-8 using the `gf_utf8_wcstombs` function. If the conversion exceeds the allocated length of `szLineConv`, it returns NULL to indicate an error. Finally, it copies the converted string back to `szLine` and handles a potential issue with reading the null terminator after a newline character. The function concludes by returning a success status, `sOK`.
